name: route53resolver
description: When you create a VPC using Amazon VPC, you automatically get DNS resolution within the VPC from Route 53 Resolver.

subcommands.name: associate-firewall-rule-group
subcommands.description: Associates a FirewallRuleGroup with a VPC, to provide DNS filtering for the VPC.

subcommands.name: associate-resolver-endpoint-ip-address
subcommands.description: Adds IP addresses to an inbound or an outbound Resolver endpoint.

subcommands.name: associate-resolver-query-log-config
subcommands.description: Associates an Amazon VPC with a specified query logging configuration.

subcommands.name: associate-resolver-rule
subcommands.description: Associates a Resolver rule with a VPC.

subcommands.name: batch-create-firewall-rule
subcommands.description: Creates multiple DNS Firewall rules in the specified rule group.

subcommands.name: batch-delete-firewall-rule
subcommands.description: Deletes multiple DNS Firewall rules from the specified rule group.

subcommands.name: batch-update-firewall-rule
subcommands.description: Updates multiple DNS Firewall rules in the specified rule group.

subcommands.name: create-firewall-domain-list
subcommands.description: Creates an empty firewall domain list for use in DNS Firewall rules.

subcommands.name: create-firewall-rule
subcommands.description: Creates a single DNS Firewall rule in the specified rule group.

subcommands.name: create-firewall-rule-group
subcommands.description: Creates an empty DNS Firewall rule group for filtering DNS network traffic in a VPC.

subcommands.name: create-outpost-resolver
subcommands.description: Creates a Route 53 Resolver on an Outpost.

subcommands.name: create-resolver-endpoint
subcommands.description: Creates a Resolver endpoint.

subcommands.name: create-resolver-query-log-config
subcommands.description: Creates a Resolver query logging configuration, which defines where you want Resolver to save DNS query logs that originate in your VPCs.

subcommands.name: create-resolver-rule
subcommands.description: For DNS queries that originate in your VPCs, specifies which Resolver endpoint the queries pass through, one domain name that you want to forward to your network, and the IP addresses of the DNS resolvers in your network.

subcommands.name: delete-firewall-domain-list
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified domain list.

subcommands.name: delete-firewall-rule
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified firewall rule.

subcommands.name: delete-firewall-rule-group
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified firewall rule group.

subcommands.name: delete-outpost-resolver
subcommands.description: Deletes a Resolver on the Outpost.

subcommands.name: delete-resolver-endpoint
subcommands.description: Deletes a Resolver endpoint.

subcommands.name: delete-resolver-query-log-config
subcommands.description: Deletes a query logging configuration.

subcommands.name: delete-resolver-rule
subcommands.description: Deletes a Resolver rule.

subcommands.name: disassociate-firewall-rule-group
subcommands.description: Disassociates a FirewallRuleGroup from a VPC, to remove DNS filtering from the VPC.

subcommands.name: disassociate-resolver-endpoint-ip-address
subcommands.description: Removes IP addresses from an inbound or an outbound Resolver endpoint.

subcommands.name: disassociate-resolver-query-log-config
subcommands.description: Disassociates a VPC from a query logging configuration.

subcommands.name: disassociate-resolver-rule
subcommands.description: Removes the association between a specified Resolver rule and a specified VPC.

subcommands.name: get-firewall-config
subcommands.description: Retrieves the configuration of the firewall behavior provided by DNS Firewall for a single VPC from Amazon Virtual Private Cloud (Amazon VPC).

subcommands.name: get-firewall-domain-list
subcommands.description: Retrieves the specified firewall domain list.

subcommands.name: get-firewall-rule-group
subcommands.description: Retrieves the specified firewall rule group.

subcommands.name: get-firewall-rule-group-association
subcommands.description: Retrieves a firewall rule group association, which enables DNS filtering for a VPC with one rule group.

subcommands.name: get-firewall-rule-group-policy
subcommands.description: Returns the Identity and Access Management (Amazon Web Services IAM) policy for sharing the specified rule group.

subcommands.name: get-outpost-resolver
subcommands.description: Gets information about a specified Resolver on the Outpost, such as its instance count and type, name, and the current status of the Resolver.

subcommands.name: get-resolver-config
subcommands.description: Retrieves the behavior configuration of Route 53 Resolver behavior for a single VPC from Amazon Virtual Private Cloud.

subcommands.name: get-resolver-dnssec-config
subcommands.description: Gets DNSSEC validation information for a specified resource.

subcommands.name: get-resolver-endpoint
subcommands.description: Gets information about a specified Resolver endpoint, such as whether it's an inbound or an outbound Resolver endpoint, and the current status of the endpoint.

subcommands.name: get-resolver-query-log-config
subcommands.description: Gets information about a specified Resolver query logging configuration, such as the number of VPCs that the configuration is logging queries for and the location that logs are sent to.

subcommands.name: get-resolver-query-log-config-association
subcommands.description: Gets information about a specified association between a Resolver query logging configuration and an Amazon VPC.

subcommands.name: get-resolver-query-log-config-policy
subcommands.description: Gets information about a query logging policy.

subcommands.name: get-resolver-rule
subcommands.description: Gets information about a specified Resolver rule, such as the domain name that the rule forwards DNS queries for and the ID of the outbound Resolver endpoint that the rule is associated with.

subcommands.name: get-resolver-rule-association
subcommands.description: Gets information about an association between a specified Resolver rule and a VPC.

subcommands.name: get-resolver-rule-policy
subcommands.description: Gets information about the Resolver rule policy for a specified rule.

subcommands.name: import-firewall-domains
subcommands.description: Imports domain names from a file into a domain list, for use in a DNS firewall rule group.

subcommands.name: list-firewall-configs
subcommands.description: Retrieves the firewall configurations that you have defined.

subcommands.name: list-firewall-domain-lists
subcommands.description: Retrieves the firewall domain lists that you have defined.

subcommands.name: list-firewall-domains
subcommands.description: Retrieves the domains that you have defined for the specified firewall domain list.

subcommands.name: list-firewall-rule-group-associations
subcommands.description: Retrieves the firewall rule group associations that you have defined.

subcommands.name: list-firewall-rule-groups
subcommands.description: Retrieves the minimal high-level information for the rule groups that you have defined.

subcommands.name: list-firewall-rule-types
subcommands.description: Retrieves the rule-type variants that can be used in the FirewallRuleType field of CreateFirewallRule and UpdateFirewallRule.

subcommands.name: list-firewall-rules
subcommands.description: Retrieves the firewall rules that you have defined for the specified firewall rule group.

subcommands.name: list-outpost-resolvers
subcommands.description: Lists all the Resolvers on Outposts that were created using the current Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: list-resolver-configs
subcommands.description: Retrieves the Resolver configurations that you have defined.

subcommands.name: list-resolver-dnssec-configs
subcommands.description: Lists the configurations for DNSSEC validation that are associated with the current Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: list-resolver-endpoint-ip-addresses
subcommands.description: Gets the IP addresses for a specified Resolver endpoint.

subcommands.name: list-resolver-endpoints
subcommands.description: Lists all the Resolver endpoints that were created using the current Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: list-resolver-query-log-config-associations
subcommands.description: Lists information about associations between Amazon VPCs and query logging configurations.

subcommands.name: list-resolver-query-log-configs
subcommands.description: Lists information about the specified query logging configurations.

subcommands.name: list-resolver-rule-associations
subcommands.description: Lists the associations that were created between Resolver rules and VPCs using the current Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: list-resolver-rules
subcommands.description: Lists the Resolver rules that were created using the current Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: Lists the tags that you associated with the specified resource.

subcommands.name: put-firewall-rule-group-policy
subcommands.description: Attaches an Identity and Access Management (Amazon Web Services IAM) policy for sharing the rule group.

subcommands.name: put-resolver-query-log-config-policy
subcommands.description: Specifies an Amazon Web Services account that you want to share a query logging configuration with, the query logging configuration that you want to share, and the operations that you want the account to be able to perform on the configuration.

subcommands.name: put-resolver-rule-policy
subcommands.description: Specifies an Amazon Web Services rule that you want to share with another account, the account that you want to share the rule with, and the operations that you want the account to be able to perform on the rule.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Adds one or more tags to a specified resource.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Removes one or more tags from a specified resource.

subcommands.name: update-firewall-config
subcommands.description: Updates the configuration of the firewall behavior provided by DNS Firewall for a single VPC from Amazon Virtual Private Cloud (Amazon VPC).

subcommands.name: update-firewall-domains
subcommands.description: Updates the firewall domain list from an array of domain specifications.

subcommands.name: update-firewall-rule
subcommands.description: Updates the specified firewall rule.

subcommands.name: update-firewall-rule-group-association
subcommands.description: Changes the association of a FirewallRuleGroup with a VPC.

subcommands.name: update-outpost-resolver
subcommands.description: You can use UpdateOutpostResolver to update the instance count, type, or name of a Resolver on an Outpost.

subcommands.name: update-resolver-config
subcommands.description: Updates the behavior configuration of Route 53 Resolver behavior for a single VPC from Amazon Virtual Private Cloud.

subcommands.name: update-resolver-dnssec-config
subcommands.description: Updates an existing DNSSEC validation configuration.

subcommands.name: update-resolver-endpoint
subcommands.description: Updates the name, or endpoint type for an inbound or an outbound Resolver endpoint.

subcommands.name: update-resolver-rule
subcommands.description: Updates settings for a specified Resolver rule.
